arxiv-2102-02812.title: Weak deflection angle by asymptotically flat black holes in Horndeski theory using Gauss-Bonnet theorem
arxiv-2102-02812.creator: WAJIHA JAVED, JAMEELA ABBAS, YASHMITHA KUMARAN, ALİ ÖVGÜN
arxiv-2102-02812.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by WAJIHA JAVED, JAMEELA ABBAS, YASHMITHA KUMARAN, ALİ ÖVGÜN. The principal objective of this project is to investigate the gravitational lensing by asymptotically flat black holes in the framework of Horndeski theory in weak field limits. To achieve this objective, we utilize the Gauss-Bonnet theorem to the optical geometry of asymptotically flat black holes and applying the Gibbons-Werner technique to achieve the deflection angle of photons in weak field limits.

arxiv-2107-04288.title: Retinal OCT Denoising with Pseudo-Multimodal Fusion Network
arxiv-2107-04288.creator: Dewei Hu, Joseph D. Malone, Yigit Atay, Yuankai K. Tao, Ipek Oguz
arxiv-2107-04288.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dewei Hu, Joseph D. Malone, Yigit Atay, Yuankai K. Tao, Ipek Oguz. Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a prevalent imaging technique for retina. However, it is affected by multiplicative speckle noise that can degrade the visibility of essential anatomical structures, including blood vessels and tissue layers. Although averaging repeated B-scan frames can significantly improve the signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR), this requires longer acquisition time, which can introduce motion artifacts and cause discomfort to patients.

arxiv-2204-01481.title: Automated Proof of Mixed Trigonometric-polynomial Inequalities in the Unbounded Case
arxiv-2204-01481.creator: Chen shiping, Ge Xinyu
arxiv-2204-01481.description: Abstract Mixed trigonometric-polynomials frequently occur in applications in physics, numerical analysis and engineering, the algorithm has been already proposed to determine its sign on ( 0 , π 2 ] (0,\frac{\pi}{2}] . This paper proposes a procedure to extend the interval to ( 0 , + ∞ ) (0,+\infty) .

arxiv-2204-03317.title: Rheology and structure of a suspension of deformable particles in plane Poiseuille flow
arxiv-2204-03317.creator: Vassanti Audemar, Thomas Podgorski, Gwennou Coupier
arxiv-2204-03317.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vassanti Audemar, Thomas Podgorski, Gwennou Coupier. We present an experimental study of the rheology and structure of a confined suspension of deformable particles flowing in a quasi-two-dimensional Poiseuille flow. Thanks to a precise microfluidic viscosimetry technique combined with measurements of concentration profiles, our study provides the first experimental confirmation with three-dimensional particles of a strong relationship between structuring effects and rheology, previously only reported in numerical simulations of purely two-dimensional systems.

arxiv-2211-05076.title: On Berman functions
arxiv-2211-05076.creator: Krzysztof Dȩbicki, Enkelejd Hashorva, Zbigniew Michna
arxiv-2211-05076.description: Abstract Abstract: Let Z(t)=\exp\left(\sqrt{2}B_{H}(t)-\left\lvert t\right\rvert^{2H}\right),t\in\mathbb{R} with B_{H}(t),t\in\mathbb{R} a standard fractional Brownian motion (fBm) with Hurst parameter H\in(0,1] and define for x non-negative the Berman function \displaystyle\mathcal{B}_{Z}(x)=\mathbb{E}\left\{\frac{\mathbb{I}{\left\{\epsilon_{0}(RZ)>x\right\}}}{\epsilon_{0}(RZ)}\right\}\in(0,\infty), where the random variable R independent of Z has survival function 1/x,x\geq 1 and \epsilon_{0}(RZ)=\int_{\mathbb{R}}\mathbb{I}{\left\{RZ(t)>1\right\}}dt.

arxiv-2306-12455.title: Gravitational lensing in a space-time with cosmic string within the Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld gravity
arxiv-2306-12455.creator: Faizuddin Ahmed
arxiv-2306-12455.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Faizuddin Ahmed. This study explores the deflection angle of photon rays or light-like geodesics within the framework of Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld (EiBI) gravity background space-time, taking into account the influence of cosmic strings. The primary focus lies in deriving the effective potential of the system applicable to both null and time-like geodesics, as well as determining the angle of deflection for light-like geodesics. Our analysis shows that the presence of cosmic strings induces modifications in these physical quantities, leading to shifts in their respective values.

arxiv-2310-14070.title: Anionic Character of the Conduction Band of Sodium Chloride
arxiv-2310-14070.creator: Christopher C. Leon, Abhishek Grewal, Klaus Kuhnke, Klaus Kern, Olle Gunnarsson
arxiv-2310-14070.description: Abstract The alkali halides are ionic compounds. Each alkali atom donates an electron to a halogen atom, leading to ions with full shells. The valence band is mainly located on halogen atoms, while, in a traditional picture, the conduction band is mainly located on alkali atoms.

arxiv-2404-14272.title: Electrical spin manipulation in double SrTiO 3 /LaAlO 3 quantum dots
arxiv-2404-14272.creator: B. Szafran, M. Zegrodnik, M. P. Nowak, R. Citro, P. Wójcik
arxiv-2404-14272.description: Abstract The spin dynamics in two electron double quantum dots embedded in two dimensional electron gas at the interface between SrTiO 3 and LaAlO 3 is studied by an exact numerical solution of the time-dependent Schrödinger equation in the context of the electric dipole spin resonance experiment.

arxiv-2501-17480.title: Magneto-optical polarisation texturing
arxiv-2501-17480.creator: K. Koksal 1,2 , F. Tambag 1 , J. Berakdar 2 , M. Babiker 3
arxiv-2501-17480.description: Abstract Left and right circularly polarized transverse electromagnetic waves propagate at slightly different speeds in a magnetic material leading to a polarization rotation by an amount proportional to the projection of the magnetic field along the direction of the wave propagation.

arxiv-2503-14281.title: XOXO: Stealthy Cross-Origin Context Poisoning Attacks against AI Coding Assistants
arxiv-2503-14281.creator: Adam Štorek, Mukur Gupta, Noopur Bhatt, Aditya Gupta, Janie Kim, Prashast Srivastava, Suman Jana
arxiv-2503-14281.description: Abstract AI coding assistants automatically gather context from potentially untrusted sources to generate code recommendations. We introduce Cross-Origin Context Poisoning (XOXO), a novel attack that exploits this automatic context inclusion by subtly manipulating code without changing its semantics. Attackers introduce semantics-preserving transformations (e.g., renamed variables) to shared code, causing AI assistants to unknowingly recommend vulnerable code patterns to victims.

arxiv-2506-22331.title: Less Greedy Equivalence Search
arxiv-2506-22331.creator: Adiba Ejaz, Elias Bareinboim
arxiv-2506-22331.description: Abstract Greedy Equivalence Search (GES) is a classic score-based algorithm for causal discovery from observational data. In the sample limit, it recovers the Markov equivalence class of graphs that describe the data. Still, it faces two challenges in practice: computational cost and finite-sample accuracy.

arxiv-2512-08457.title: Modeling the Effects of Slip, Twinning, and Notch on the Deformation of Single-Crystal Austenitic Manganese Steel Journal: International Journal of Plasticity
arxiv-2512-08457.creator: S. Virupakshi, X. Zheng, K. Frydrych, I. Karaman, A. Srivastava, K. Kowalczyk-Gajewska
arxiv-2512-08457.description: Abstract The objective of this work is to deconvolute the interaction of slip, twinning, and notch on the deformation response of an austenitic manganese (Hadfield) steel using detailed finite element simulations. The simulations employ a rate-dependent crystal plasticity constitutive model that incorporates both slip and twinning deformation mechanisms.

arxiv-2512-19363.title: From Points to Coalitions: Hierarchical Contrastive Shapley Values for Prioritizing Data Samples
arxiv-2512-19363.creator: Canran Xiao, Jiabao Dou, Zhiming Lin, Zong Ke, Liwei Hou
arxiv-2512-19363.description: Abstract How should we quantify the value of each training example when datasets are large, heterogeneous, and geometrically structured? Classical Data‑Shapley answers in principle, but its O ⁡ ( n ! ) O(n!) complexity and point‑wise perspective are ill‑suited to modern scales.

arxiv-2601-14279.title: On the Limits of Learned Importance Scoring for KV Cache Compression
arxiv-2601-14279.creator: Brady Steele
arxiv-2601-14279.description: Abstract We investigate learned KV cache compression through Speculative Importance Prediction (SIP), a 1.7M parameter non-query-aware scorer that predicts token importance from KV representations alone. Despite architectural sophistication (multi-horizon lookahead, cross-attention), SIP does not outperform simple baselines, including random selection, across 5 seeds, 4 retention levels, and 3 tasks.

doe-osti-2584398-benchmark-tracking-syst.creator: Billingsley, Braedon, Cottam, Joseph A.
doe-osti-2584398-benchmark-tracking-syst.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. Benchmarking is essential for high-performance software development, particularly for monitoring performance across code iterations. This project focused on enhancing the benchmarking process for Lamellar, an asynchronous runtime for High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems devel

pmc-10626640.title: Secular trends in the incidence of major depressive disorder and dysthymia in China from 1990 to 2019
pmc-10626640.creator: Ming Li, Wenlong Gao, Yuqi Zhang, Qiuxia Luo, Yuanyuan Xiang, Kai Bao, Noha Zaki
pmc-10626640.description: BackgroundDepression is increasingly recognized as a worldwide serious, public health concern. A better understanding of depression is important for advancing its management and learning the difference between major depressive disorder (MDD) and dysthymia. Our aim is to conduct a concurrent analysis of the trends of both MDD and dysthymia in China.

pmc-10691963.title: Subgraph extraction and graph representation learning for single cell Hi-C imputation and clustering
pmc-10691963.creator: Jiahao Zheng, Yuedong Yang, Zhiming Dai
pmc-10691963.description: Single-cell Hi-C (scHi-C) technology enables the investigation of 3D chromatin structure variability across individual cells. However, the analysis of scHi-C data is challenged by a large number of missing values. Here, we present a scHi-C data imputation model HiC-SGL, based on Subgraph extraction and graph representation learning. HiC-SGL can also learn informative low-dimensional embeddings of cells.

pmc-10747628.title: The Acceptability of Pharmacy-Based HPV Vaccination in Western Kenya among Pharmacy Clients and Providers
pmc-10747628.creator: Shengruo Zhang, Benn Kwach, Victor Omollo, Magdaline Asewe, Rachel C Malen, Parth D Shah, Josephine Odoyo, Nelly Mugo, Kenneth Ngure, Elizabeth A Bukusi, Katrina F Ortblad, Giuseppe La Torre
pmc-10747628.description: Vaccine coverage for the human papillomavirus (HPV) remains low globally, and differentiated models of vaccine delivery are needed to expand access. Pharmacy-based models of the HPV vaccination may engage women who could benefit. We assessed the acceptability of such a model among pharmacy clients and providers at 20 private pharmacies in Kisumu County, Kenya.

pmc-11397941.title: A Review of Vision-Based Pothole Detection Methods Using Computer Vision and Machine Learning
pmc-11397941.creator: Yashar Safyari, Masoud Mahdianpari, Hodjat Shiri, Mattia Previtali
pmc-11397941.description: Potholes and other road surface damages pose significant risks to vehicles and traffic safety. The current methods of in situ visual inspection for potholes or cracks are inefficient, costly, and hazardous. Therefore, there is a pressing need to develop automated systems for assessing road surface conditions, aiming to efficiently and accurately reconstruct, recognize, and locate potholes.

pmc-11575419.title: Alterations in purine and pyrimidine metabolism associated with latent tuberculosis infection: insights from gut microbiome and metabolomics analyses
pmc-11575419.creator: Boyi Yang, Xiaojing Guo, Chongyu Shi, Gang Liu, Xiaoling Qin, Shiyi Chen, Li Gan, Dongxu Liang, Kai Shao, Ruolan Xu, Jieqing Zhong, Yujie Mo, Hai Li, Dan Luo
pmc-11575419.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Individuals with latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) account for almost 30% of the population worldwide and have the potential to develop active tuberculosis (ATB). Despite this, the current understanding of the pathogenesis of LTBI is limited. The gut microbiome can be altered in tuberculosis patients, and an understanding of the changes associated with the progression from good health to LTBI to ATB can provide novel perspectives for understanding the pathogenesis of LTBI by identifying microbial and molecular biomarkers associated therewith.

pmc-12093536.title: Clinical indications and future directions of carbon-ion radiotherapy: a narrative review
pmc-12093536.creator: Seo Hee Choi, Woong Sub Koom, Hong In Yoon, Kyung Hwan Kim, Chan Woo Wee, Jaeho Cho, Yong Bae Kim, Ki Chang Keum, Ik Jae Lee
pmc-12093536.description: Carbon-ion radiotherapy (CIRT) offers superior dose distributions and greater biological effectiveness than conventional photon-based radiotherapy (RT). Due to its higher linear energy transfer and relative biological effectiveness, CIRT is particularly effective against radioresistant tumors and those located near critical organs.

pmc-12124807.title: Adaptation of the Information, Motivation, and Behavioral Skills Framework for Understanding COVID-19 Prevention Behaviors among Youth and Young Adults by Sexual Identity, Gender Identity and Race/Ethnicity
pmc-12124807.creator: Gregory Phillips, Jiayi Xu, Michael G Curtis, Megan M Ruprecht, Shahin Davoudpour, Joseph Choi, Kay Quiballo, Sophia Huang, Kathryn Macapagal
pmc-12124807.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Youth and young adults (YYA) have been uniquely affected by COVID-19. Behavioral models have not yet been applied to understand YYA’s preventive behavior, though the Information–Motivation–Behavior (IMB) model may be appropriate. We used data from a national, diverse survey of COVID-19 effects and prevention behaviors in YYA ages 14–24 (n = 1026) and conducted an exploratory factor analysis and bivariate linear regressions to assess the association between demographics and IMB measures.

pmc-12530352.title: Case report: pierced-balloon technique for navigating difficult side branch angulation in a critical left main coronary artery bifurcation disease
pmc-12530352.creator: Veena Nanjappa, R Sreedhara, K S Sadanand, K S Ravindranath, Andrew Peter Vanezis, Ryaan El-Andari, Antonios Karanasos, Deepti Ranganathan
pmc-12530352.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDual lumen microcatheters are required to navigate angulated and diseased side branch. Many a times, they are not available.Case summaryWe used an alternative inexpensive pierced-balloon technique to manoeuver coronary wire across a diseased and angulated left circumflex artery in a case of distal critical bifurcation disease of the left main coronary artery in a 57-year-old gentleman who presented with non-ST elevation myocardial infarction.DiscussionThis technique can be used as an alternative to double lumen microcatheter when the latter is unavailable.

pmc-13221686.title: Product Reformulation in Response to the 2016 FDA Updated Nutrition Facts Label
pmc-13221686.creator: C. Ross Hatton, Joshua Petimar, Yutong Zhang, Caroline E. Collis, Tao Hou, Alexandra Ross, Michele Polacsek, Anna H. Grummon, Eric B. Rimm, Jason P. Block
pmc-13221686.description: This cohort study examines whether changes in the nutritional profiles of packaged foods in the US are associated with the adoption of the revised Nutrition Facts label. Introduction Poor diet is a major risk factor for several leading causes of death in the US, including heart disease, diabetes, and certain cancers.

pmc-13385081.title: Quality over quantity: early performance predicts suturing proficiency in robotic surgery simulation
pmc-13385081.creator: Júlia Iaroseski, André Vicente Bigolin, Sofia Galvão Lima, Silvio César Cazella
pmc-13385081.description: Robotic surgery training increasingly relies on simulation-based curricula and objective performance metrics; however, it remains unclear whether early simulator performance predicts later proficiency in complex robotic tasks. This retrospective observational cohort study analyzed simulation training data from the Simulation Center of Santa Casa de Porto Alegre, Brazil, collected between 2020 and 2024.

pmc-13531905.title: Working conditions and mental health of employees suffering from common mental disorders in Germany with special consideration to the migration generation
pmc-13531905.creator: Regina Herold, Yesim Erim, Ute B Schröder, Meike Heming, Eva Rothermund-Nassir, Jeannette Weber, Nicole Rosalinde Hander, Eva Morawa
pmc-13531905.description: PurposeThis study examines working conditions, mental health and their association among mentally burdened employees in Germany attending psychotherapeutic consultation at work, considering first- and second-generation migrants.MethodsBaseline data from a randomized controlled trial on psychotherapeutic consultation at work (friaa study) were analyzed.

pmc-13548286.title: Targeting the PD-L1-induced PDK4/GLS metabolic axis overcomes anti-PD-1 resistance in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13548286.creator: Wenxin Lian, Hui Yang, Yuqi Zhang, Chenchen Liu, Chunyao Fang, Mengyue Xu, Yixing Yang, Yan Wang, Runqiu Jiang, Jing Xu, Wen Gao
pmc-13548286.description: BackgroundMetabolic reprogramming within the tumor microenvironment is a pivotal barrier to effective immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). While programmed death ligand 1 (PD-L1) is well characterized as a ligand inhibiting T-cell function, its intrinsic ‘reverse signaling’ role in regulating tumor metabolism and shaping the immune landscape remains poorly understood.
